description: Runs a notebook and waits for completion. Polls job status every 5 seconds until terminal state (Completed/Failed/Cancelled) or timeout.
notes: Without --wait, returns status started and jobId plus jobReceipt/receiptPersisted/retryAllowed:false. RECEIPT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED warns when local storage fails after acceptance; retain stdout privately and never resubmit to recreate a receipt. Observation failures retain exact scope. --cancel-on-timeout only requests cancellation: cancel_requested is not a terminal cancelled state. Use --parameters '[{"name":"p1","value":"v1","type":"Text"}]'. Spark cold start can take minutes.
